summary: On June 30, 2026, J.P. Morgan Real Estate Income Trust, Inc. filed Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare monthly distributions for six classes of common stock (Classes I, D, T, E, Y, S, X). Gross distribution amounts range from $0.0423 to $0.0000 per share, with net amounts after servicing fees ranging from $0.0343 to $0.0423. The record date is June 30, 2026, with payment on or about July 6, 2026, in cash or via reinvestment plan. Class D servicing fees were waived for June 2026. This is a routine distribution announcement, not a special situation.
